provenance.issuers: Fictional legal names and tickers. Amounts are invented.
provenance.license: Benchmark generator and labels are part of this repository and covered by its MIT license. The passages are not SEC filings, not EDGAR excerpts, and not factual financial statements.
provenance.split: sha256(task_id) first byte < 77 is dev (about 30 percent); the remainder is test. The reported table is the test split. The dev split was not used to choose a retriever, a cutoff, or a validator.

setup.dense_encoder: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2; weights SHA-256 53aa51172d142c89d9012cce15ae4d6cc0ca6895895114379cacb4fab128d9db; sentence-transformers 6.2.0; torch 2.15.0; device cpu; normalize_embeddings=True.
setup.ndcg: Macro-average nDCG with grades 2 (required filing) and 0 (everything else), log base 2.
setup.query: Paraphrased claim text only. Company and fiscal-period fields are not appended to the query.
setup.recall: Macro-average over test tasks that have at least one grade-2 document. Grade 2 is a required canonical filing.
setup.reranker: Existing MetadataBoostReranker on the candidate pool, using due-diligence target company, fiscal period, sec_filing source, and metric.
setup.svd: Same TF-IDF subspace settings as the 60-task CPU run: dimension 32, min_df 2, 15 iterations.
setup.tie_break: Higher score, then higher document_id. is_distractor is false for every row.
setup.verdict: Among the method's top 5 documents, keep rows whose extracted company, fiscal period, and metric match the subclaim, take the best-ranked remaining row, then run FiscalPeriodValidator and NumericValidator. Comparison and margin tasks use the best-ranked extracted amounts for each required fact. full_engine ranks the whole corpus by those metadata fields before the same validators. Active ranking and prediction receive public fields only.
